consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the performance was strong, with standout moments in the second set, particularly during the Scarlet>Fire sequence. Many reviewers praised the inspired playing and the overall vibe of the show, despite some mixed feelings about its length compared to other shows on the tour.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.3 for 31 reviews + 0.5 sentiment: While many fans enjoyed the show and highlighted specific performances, there were also criticisms regarding its pacing and comparison to other shows, leading to a mixed overall sentiment.
